title: Customer briefing: streamlined RCA workflow and statuspage timeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: produce a single, customer-ready incident briefing and consolidated RCA timeline for the capacity/regression event on 2026-02-27 and implement a repeatable workflow to reduce time-to-publish for future incidents. Goals: (1) create a canonical external timeline/FAQ that maps to Statuspage entries and customer emails; (2) define owners and SLAs for each postmortem step (draft, legal review, engineering validation, customer review, publish); (3) implement tooling and small automations to reduce manual handoffs (templated statuspage updates, automated timeline generation from incident logs).
actions: Draft external-facing RCA summary (owner: Lucas Moreno) - include timeline, impact, root cause, mitigations, next steps
Publish consolidated timeline to Statuspage and link to RCAs (owner: PM - Priya Singh)
Produce internal technical annex with logs and kernel-level traces (owner: Eng - Samir Kaur)
Coordinate legal/PR review for customer language (owner: Legal - Tara Brooks)
Schedule targeted customer outreach for top-10 impacted tenants (owner: Customer Success - Diego Ramos)
Create follow-up engineering tickets for automation: statuspage templating, timeline extraction script (owner: Platform - Asha Patel)
acceptance_criteria: External RCA draft reviewed and approved by Engineering, PM, and Legal
Statuspage entry updated with canonical timeline and linked to RCA PDF
Top-10 impacted customers contacted with tailored summary and next-step offer
Automation tickets created and prioritized in backlog (IDs linked in comments)
